alignments.note: The particle גַּם takes the connective adverb the ASV writes for it, *moreover*.
Finite verb with its subject pronoun and auxiliary under rule 17; headed on the lexical verb *seen* by rule 24. Unit is discontinuous around the negative's *not* under rule 25.
The negative takes its own written *not*.
No article morpheme is segmented on שֶׁמֶשׁ, so the supplied *the* determines the nominal expression and joins the noun's unit under rule 15; it is never the head.
Waw plus לֹא rendered by the single word *nor*, which carries both the coordination and the negation: one unit under rules 30 and 35, headed on the negative.
The verb keeps its lexical rendering; the auxiliary *hath* of the first clause is not repeated here.

No object morpheme stands in the clause — יָדָע is written bare — so the supplied object pronoun *it* answers to nothing and is `added` under rules 44 and 30; it does not join the verb merely by standing beside it. The margin's *Or, neither had any knowledge* was read and set aside under rule 38.

Verbless possessive clause: the possessive לְ is what makes it possessive and carries the supplied *hath* under rule 43; the demonstrative keeps only its own word. The margin's *Or, it is better with this than with the other* was read and set aside under rule 38.
The possessed noun keeps only its own English word.

Comparative מִן rendered by the two-word English comparative *rather than*, one rendering of which no morpheme owns a part (rule 30's one-rendering reading); headed on *than*, the word carrying the comparative relation, under rule 24. Heading on *rather* was the competing reading and was not taken.
The second demonstrative is rendered contrastively as *the other*; the supplied determiner joins that nominal expression under rule 15 and the head stays on the word carrying the lexeme.

review_notes: Both marginal notes were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.
*it* at t010 is the only `added` unit: the Hebrew writes no object suffix on יָדָע.
גַּם is aligned to *moreover* rather than treated as an unrendered particle, since the ASV writes a connective adverb in its slot.
